purpose: Static concept for the common page content below the hero transition, using the current documented product scope as a working assumption
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset: high-fidelity PRYDD landing-page concept showing the COMMON CONTENT BELOW the hero transition. It is a pre-code design discussion mockup, not a live site. Create one tall portrait image of a continuous desktop webpage scroll, flat front-facing UI, with four sections stacked vertically. No board gutter, no phone or computer hardware, no browser chrome, no numbered frames, no hero section at the top.
Input image 1 is only a brand/type/palette reference: its correct PRYDD wordmark and silhouette, off-white/near-black/electric-blue colours, bold clean geometric Montserrat-style headings. Input image 2 is only a reference for simple recipient/amount/payment-result UI. Do not reproduce their collage/storyboard layouts.
Goal: combine Wise's confident scale and substantial rounded panels with Altitude.xyz's focused product crop beside very short text. Visitors should understand money entering, being held and reaching a person visually. Keep large margins, generous whitespace, few elements, restrained shadows, clean exact text and hierarchy. White/blue is provisional for layout comparison.
SECTION 1 on an off-white backdrop: left short title exact "From local money to dollars." and one small supporting sentence exact "Add money from local currency. Hold a USD balance in PRYDD." Right a broad very pale blue rounded visual panel with two simple visual objects connected by an arrow: "Local money" and "USD balance", with illustrative balance "$250.00". No bank names, named currencies other than USD, rates or conversion-fee claims. The visual should look like a clear lightweight product illustration, not a dense transfer calculator. Title is large but smaller than a hero headline.
SECTION 2: alternate composition with the product visual on the left and text on the right. Text title exact "Your money, in one view." and supporting sentence exact "See your dollar balance and the payments you send and receive." Large rounded near-black section/panel creates contrast in the page; white text. Show one off-white account-interface crop with PRYDD label, "USD balance", "$250.00", and two quiet activity entries "From @sarah" "+$50.00" "Received" "Today"; "To @leo" "-$25.00" "Sent" "Today". No spending card UI, card-payment icon or recovery claim. Balance dominates, activity reads clearly.
SECTION 3 on white: left title exact "Send to a username." and one supporting sentence exact "Move dollars to another PRYDD user." Right one rounded pale-blue visual panel: a natural photographic portrait of an adult resolves to the username "@maya"; beside it a simple "$25.00" amount and blue completion tick. The portrait, username and amount look coherent and make the action obvious. This is a quiet explanation, not a second multi-step storyboard or three-card feature grid. No extra paragraph or extra feature.
SECTION 4: spacious electric blue #2457F5 closing invitation with a few small photographic tiles forming a very subtle partial globe arc near the outer corners, plenty of completely empty space in the middle. White large exact headline "Everyday global money starts here." One short white sentence exact "Join PRYDD’s early-access list." One off-white pill button with cobalt label exact "Join early access". Keep photos off all copy. Very restrained small footer below, with PRYDD symbol + wordmark and only the simple links "Privacy" and "Terms". No invented social proof, statistics, testimonials or extra text.
Use the attached symbol silhouette, spell PRYDD P-R-Y-D-D exactly. Preserve realistic skin tones. All amounts and usernames are illustrative. Do not add any promise about speed, fees, rewards, interest, countries, licensed banking, card spending, multi-currency holding or security. Do not add repeated product overviews, stock market charts or navigation bars. The result is an elegant coherent page crop with genuinely readable text and strong visual storytelling.
